therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: exenatide once weekly vs exenatide twice daily
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: glucose-dependent insulin secretion and glucagon suppression
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Change in HbA1c from baseline to Week 24

results.effect_size: LS mean difference -0.67% HbA1c (95% CI: -0.94 to -0.39) favoring once weekly
biomarker_changes: Exenatide once weekly: fasting plasma glucose -25.1 mg/dL vs -4.6 mg/dL for twice daily (p=0.0006)
Exenatide once weekly: total cholesterol -15.4 mg/dL vs +0.6 mg/dL for twice daily (p<0.0001)
Exenatide once weekly: triglycerides ratio 0.94 vs 0.99 for twice daily (p=0.2558)
Exenatide once weekly: HDL change 0.0 mg/dL vs +1.3 mg/dL for twice daily (p=0.1251)
Body weight change: -2.33 kg (once weekly) vs -1.37 kg (twice daily), difference -0.95 kg (p=0.0514)
Systolic BP change: -2.9 mmHg (once weekly) vs -1.2 mmHg (twice daily), p=0.2367
subgroup_findings: 58.1% of once weekly vs 30.1% of twice daily subjects achieved HbA1c <7% (p<0.0001)
41.1% of once weekly vs 16.3% of twice daily subjects achieved HbA1c ≤6.5% (p<0.0001)
50.4% of once weekly vs 30.9% of twice daily subjects achieved fasting plasma glucose ≤126 mg/dL (p=0.0008)
Minor hypoglycemia rate with sulfonylurea: 0.75/subject-year (once weekly) vs 0.31/subject-year (twice daily); no events without sulfonylurea in either arm
safety_signals: Pancreatitis reported as SAE in 1 subject in exenatide once weekly arm
No major hypoglycemic events in either arm
Minor hypoglycemic events occurred only in subjects on concomitant sulfonylurea

dose_info.dose: 2.0 mg (once weekly); 5 mcg escalating to 10 mcg (twice daily)
dose_info.schedule: once weekly (once weekly arm); twice daily with 4-week 5 mcg lead-in then 10 mcg for 20 weeks (twice daily arm)

results_by_chain.population_description: Adults with type 2 diabetes mellitus treated with subcutaneous exenatide once weekly
